_note: Agent registry for the demo. Permissions are enforced by the simulated policy engine (lib/governance.ts).

agents.name: Methanol Operations Agent
agents.mission: Coordinates the council, detects plant-wide deviations, consolidates findings and escalates to humans.

agents.name: Process Agent
agents.mission: Analyses process behaviour: loop hydraulics, reaction conditions, mass & energy balances.

agents.name: Asset Agent
agents.mission: Evaluates equipment condition, machinery health, maintenance history and reliability risk.

agents.name: Energy Agent
agents.mission: Tracks energy intensity, steam balance, compressor power and reformer duty.

agents.name: Quality Agent
agents.mission: Monitors methanol purity, impurities and distillation performance; predicts off-spec risk.

agents.name: HSE Agent
agents.mission: Validates every recommendation against the demo operating envelope, permits and safety rules.

agents.name: Engineering Agent
agents.mission: Retrieves and interprets SOPs, P&IDs, OEM manuals, MOC and incident history.

agents.name: Production Agent
agents.mission: Quantifies production and commercial impact against plan, inventory and cargo commitments.

agents.name: Shift Agent
agents.mission: Maintains shift context, logbook entries and the AI-drafted handover.
